Notes.Name: Check Remote Desktop Protocol Port
Notes.Details: Using the Test-NetConnection cmdlet you can confirm that a server is reachable via the standard RDP port of 3389.

Notes.Name: Check if Port is Open
Notes.Details: Just supply an IP Address and Port number and it will return true or false, based on if it was able to connect.

Notes.Name: Get Your Local IP Address
Notes.Details: Get-NetIPAddress returns the all the local IP addresses of the machine it is run on.

Notes.Name: Get External IP Address
Notes.Details: Uses the ipify API to return your external IP address

Notes.Name: Get IP from Host Name
Notes.Details: Get the IP address based on the host name

Notes.Name: Get Host Name from IP
Notes.Details: Get the host name from an IP address
